mhm.review:
MHM is one of the few faculty members in NSU who is an absolute legend, but people don't get him properly.
After completing BUS172 & 173 back-to-back in two semesters under his instruction, I can confidently claim that I won't forget anything of Statistics at least within 2-3 years. The way he teaches every concept in a detailed manner, I can't express with words how good he is in teaching

MHM will take 9 quizzes and will count all of them. 2 ta mid each of 100 marks. Final of 100 marks. Onek attentive thakte hobe almost all classes korte hobe and you have to focus on his lecture more than his slides which are not very detailed. Judi shob thik thak thake taile bhalo grade dibe curve o korbe.

MHM: THE MYTH,THE LEGEND
The 1 & Only G.O.A.T of NSU
Mhm bhalo hbe bt u have to give effort

He explains the basics of every topic in class clearly. Sometimes you may feel a bit lost, but if you take notes and revise, you'll understand everything pretty easily. He is quite flexible with exams, he allows make-up exams if you miss for a valid reason. He also provides practice questions before every exam. If you practice them well, you’re good to go. And yes, there’s also a group project.

If you wanna really learn something then MHM
Ar jodi easygoing then Mja1
MHM.. Totally friendly and mind blowing faculty.
MHM gives a lot of quizzes (often around 7-9) and expects high attentiveness, but is exceptional for learning if you put in the effort.

rue.review: Rue sir is really good , sir teaches well, gives a lot of practice work and you get full marks for assignment just for doing them you don't have to be right or wrong, sir is really understanding if you are late to class for a valid reason he will give you attendence, takes best 2 quiz out of 3 and takes 2 mids and counts the best one also gives chance for an improvement mid or quiz incase you do bad in one and does not include any penalty mark, also sir curves a bit.
Questions are kinda hard and you need to put more effort to understand the classes, lectures are hard to understand there would be no suggestion math problems mid or final.

I've had a very hectic time in RUE Sir's class this semester. The classes were very unorganised, course content mentioned in course outline were not entirely covered (around 3 major topics were not taught), all the class quizzes, mids were held on topics never taught and we were expected to know formulas out of nowhere. Unless you have studied statistics in the past, this course can be very difficult for you. I self-studied this subject the whole semester and had to refer to my A Levels Statistics textbook back and forth for the concepts.
